visibility.reason: Transition utility; not a material-fit knob.

tint.reason: Tint is represented by the tintAlpha attribution scan; no two-scene promotion has been accepted.

thickness.reason: Recovered per-geometry values (12 px toolbar, 8 px capsules) are not a frozen shared-parameter proof.

edgeRefraction.reason: The retained edge scan moves by less than the promotion threshold and does not justify changing the shipped named preset.

delta.note: small movement within noise; no accepted promotion

refractionSpread.reason: No shared spread value closes the capsule generalization gap; the best coupled row remains about 2.01x toolbar combined error.

backdropScale.reason: The C1 contour-safe control is retained as an opt-in material axis, but the pinned tab-bar holdout prefers neutral 1.0, so no Apple preset is changed.

frost.reason: Scene optima disagree (small 5, toolbar 7, large 8); the clear 0-2 endpoint scan is still required.

chromaticAberration.reason: Values 0 through 0.01 are byte-identical in all three scenes; larger values do not improve score.

saturation.reason: No retained two-scene attribution row is present in the current ledger.

transmissionGamma.reason: Gamma movement is small and no cross-scene promotion has been accepted.

vibrancy.reason: The small-scene candidate does not establish a retained shared-vector improvement.

highlight.reason: Highlight 0.4 improves the frost-zero bevel objective on all three shapes and is the toolbar/card optimum in the measured sweep.

highlightOppositeStrength.reason: The opposing highlight lobe is implemented and covered by renderer tests, but its independent multi-shape visual fit has not been retained as a standalone harness artifact.

highlightWidth.reason: An independent 0.75 px highlight band improves the retained lighting fit without coupling highlight placement to the darker contour width or adding a pass or texture sample.

delta.note: Retained shared width from the lighting-reset-49 sweep.

highlightWrap.reason: Zero wrap improves the toolbar and capsule bevel objectives and is pixel-neutral on the rounded card at frost zero.

curvatureLighting.reason: A cached analytic curvature field reduces mechanically uniform straight-section lighting on the capsule and rounded-superellipse card without changing the circle or adding a texture sample/pass.

contourStrength.reason: The shared 0.2 contour strength improves the frost-zero boundary objective over 0.05 on toolbar, capsule, and card; larger strength is shape-sensitive and is not promoted.

contourWidth.reason: Explicit geometry-tuning utility: iteration 102 proves incompatible width optima across compact toolbar, capsule, and card, so the control must remain configurable and 0.5 remains the conservative shared default.

contourOffset.reason: Signed-distance placement moves the attached contour outside the mathematical path and improves white-boundary error on circle, capsule, and card with all canvas shadows disabled.

contourTransmittance.reason: Explicit material-tuning utility: compact toolbar glass prefers lower contour transmission while both larger material shapes prefer higher transmission; 0.8 remains the no-toolbar-sacrifice compromise.

bevelShadowStrength.reason: Strength 0.02 paired with the fitted 16px depth improves the frost-zero bevel objective across toolbar, capsule, and card.

bevelShadowDepth.reason: A 16px SDF-following band paired with strength 0.02 improves all three frost-zero shape objectives.

bevelShadowOffset.reason: A 4 px directional offset makes the SDF-following inner shadow visible on the opposite-light face while preserving the contour-following band.

delta.note: Retained from the lighting-reset-47 directional inner-shadow fit.

bevelShadowSizeResponse.reason: The validated card sweep rejects size-dependent bevel energy for the current model; the iOS preset therefore keeps this control neutral at zero.

exteriorShadowSizeResponse.reason: Size-aware caller shadow growth is exposed, but it has not completed the independent two-scene visual evidence gate.

bevelShadowDirectionality.reason: A 0.75-directional bevel improves the validated frost-zero inner-shadow objective on circle, capsule, and card without changing transmission, frost, contour, or highlight.
